info.name: TadoX API Collection
info.description: Tado X (Hops) API requests. There is no official Tado X API documentation. Copyright (C) 2026 banter240/tado_hijack contributors. Extended from gedhi/tadox-postman-collection (https://github.com/gedhi/tadox-postman-collection). Licensed GPL-3.0: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html. Covers hops.tado.com plus the classic v2 (my.tado.com) endpoints a Tado X home also accepts. A Hops 404 is not 'no X hardware'. Generation is on GET /api/v2/homes/{{homeId}}, not on /me. Community classic v2 OpenAPI spec: https://github.com/kritsel/tado-openapispec-v2. Other undocumented tado.com subdomains have been reported (tariff-experience, susi) and are not covered here.

item.name: Set Manual Control
item.description: Sets manual control for a specific room.

item.name: Get Homes
item.description: Returns every home on the account (id, name). Generation is not in this payload. The test script stores homes[0] only.

item.name: Get Home Data
item.description: generation is LINE_X or null. zonesCount is the classic zone count and stays 0 when the rooms live on Hops.

request.description: Classic endpoint. Answers an empty array on classic V3+ homes but returns content on Tado X homes. The installation id is not the home id. On X prefer Get Rooms and Devices.

item.name: Domestic Hot Water (Internet Bridge programmer)
item.description: Captured 2026-05-31 from a Tado X Internet Bridge IB02 programmer. Power ON/OFF, no temperature. Home id omitted; use {{homeId}}.

item.name: Probe 2026-10-15 (empty homes)
item.description: GETs missing from the main folders, read 2026-10-15 on one login with two homes (one LINE_X, one classic). A Hops 404 is generation- or installation-dependent, not proof an endpoint does not exist. No saved bodies.

item.name: Hops heat pump
item.description: 404 Heat pump not found, on an empty home and on a LINE_X home with no heat pump.

item.name: Hops flow temperature
item.description: 404 There needs to be at least one RU/TR/PR with an active OpenTherm interface. A TR04 relay does not count.

item.name: Hops air comfort
item.description: 403 on a home with generation null. 200 {comfort, freshness} on LINE_X.

item.name: Hops state
item.description: 404 Resource not found. Presence stays on classic GET /state.

item.name: Hops room schedule
item.description: 200 {otherRooms, room, schedule} when the room exists.

item.name: Classic home state
item.description: 200 {presence, presenceLocked}. HOME and unlocked on both probed homes.

item.name: Classic air comfort
item.description: 200. freshness UNKNOWN and comfort empty on both probed homes.

item.name: Classic heating system
item.description: 200 {boiler: null, underfloorHeating: null}. The boiler and underfloorHeating subpaths are forbidden.

item.name: Classic incident detection
item.description: 200 {supported: true, enabled: true} even with no hardware.

item.name: Write endpoints (2026-11-12)
item.description: Hops write endpoints verified against working requests. Payload shapes are the exact bodies the API accepts.

item.name: Classic v2 endpoints that also work on Tado X homes (2026-11-12)
item.description: Classic v2 and EIQ endpoints a LINE_X home accepts although Hops does not cover them. Presence, state and meter readings answer on both generations; timetable, defaultOverlay, heatingCircuit and zone control are classic-generation homes only.
